query: 物理风险 (极端天气/海平面) 物理风险 (极端天气/海平面) 衡量企业识别、评估与管理极端天气、海平面上升等气候物理风险的能力。 重点考察：风险识别完整性、资产暴露评估深度、适应措施与业务连续性安排。 内容质量得分 • 2分：系统识别急性和慢性风险，覆盖关键资产/供应链，有量化暴露评估、适应措施及应急恢复机制。 • 1分：有风险识别与原则性措施，但缺少系统化评估或具体实施路径。 • 0分：无相关披露。 气候物理风险 急性物理风险 慢性物理风险 极端天气 暴雨 洪水 沿海洪水 台风 风暴潮 热浪 长期高温 干旱 野火 海平面上升 降水模式变化 资产暴露 气候适应 业务连续性 韧性措施 physical climate risk acute physical risk chronic physical risk extreme weather heavy precipitation flood coastal flooding typhoon storm surge heatwave chronic heat drought wildfire sea level rise changing precipitation patterns asset exposure climate adaptation business continuity resilience measures 企业识别了哪些急性物理风险（如台风、洪水、热浪）？ 是否识别海平面上升、长期高温等慢性风险？ 是否评估关键资产、运营点或供应链暴露？ 是否披露适应措施、加固改造或应急恢复安排？ 是否有量化暴露或损失评估？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '物理风险 (极端天气/海平面)'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业识别了哪些急性物理风险（如台风、洪水、热浪）？ 是否识别海平面上升、长期高温等慢性风险？ 是否评估关键资产、运营点或供应链暴露？ 是否披露适应措施、加固改造或应急恢复安排？ 是否有量化暴露或损失评估？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有转型风险（政策、诉讼、融资）；仅有减排目标；仅有泛化气候风险管理而无物理风险内容；仅有社区防灾公益项目而无企业资产风险；区分：物理风险聚焦极端天气与海平面等物理影响及适应措施；转型风险聚焦政策法律资金变化；场景分析是评估方法，可服务物理与转型风险，但不能替代具体物理风险识别与适应披露；TCFD披露是框架完整性，不等于本指标内容充分。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

It includes the manufacturing process, product quality, work environment and resources equipment for mitigate the negative impact.

results.section: GREEN INNOVATION TO PROTECT THE ENVIRONMENT 綠色創新 守護環境 / Electricity Consumption Management
results.text: We have identified more energy saving and carbon reduction measures at the operational level through systematic monitoring and regular assessment. In terms of the use of renewable energy, Shanghai Pacific has initiated the 'Distributed Photovoltaic Power Generation Project' ( 分布式光伏發電項 目 ) during the year. Xiamen Pacific has installed a photovoltaic power generation system on the roof of a workshop in 2021, and started using it for power generation in January 2022. Xiamen Pacific also planned to install the photovoltaic power generation system to the roof of other two workshops. Huizhou Singamas has evaluated the possibilities of carrying out photovoltaic power generation projects with its roof. In the future, the Group will actively look for opportunities to use more renewable energy, reduce electricity consumption and reduce carbon emissions.

In the future, the Group will actively look for opportunities to use more renewable energy, reduce electricity consumption and reduce carbon emissions.

results.text: The steadily growing of the Group's business depends on the reliable support of suppliers. The Group also makes every effort to establish a good partnership with our suppliers. In order to promote suppliers' business and cooperation, the Group develops a flexible procurement work process standard to meet the different needs of the supply chain. The Group would always ensure that the number of suppliers of the same type of raw materials to be maintained at two or more, which guarantee a stable supply of raw materials; at the same time, we would also always pay attention to the market trends to stay alert and response to the corresponding situation accordingly.
